unit.why: A verse interpretation (Ps. 119) set in a minimal narrative: the holy master is arrested after a slanderous accusation by gentiles, is afraid it may be God's decree, then calms himself and rejoices.
unit.boundary_note: Numbered item (סו) in a series of psalm interpretations; the narrative is embedded in exegesis.

stories.summary_en: When the holy master was imprisoned after gentiles slandered him, he read 'princes persecute me without cause, but my heart fears Your word' as fear that the arrest might be God's will, then settled himself to rejoice in it as God's decree.

tags.why: Mainly an exegesis of a psalm verse with a narrative frame in brackets.
